source_name: PRH Open Data — YTJ API v3 (companies)
organization: Finnish Patent and Registration Office (PRH) + Finnish Tax Administration (Business Information System / YTJ)
record_shape: envelope { totalResults, companies[] }; each company is a nested object with arrays for names, forms, registered entries and addresses, and multilingual descriptions[] (languageCode 1=fi, 2=sv, 3=en)
coverage_note: Coverage figures are from a 100-record live sample of 819,096 total. Sample skews to old/low business IDs, so many entities are ceased (tradeRegisterStatus=4); active-entity field coverage (addresses, website) is higher in the live register than the sample percentages suggest.

fields.meaning: Finnish Business ID (Y-tunnus), the national company identifier. Format NNNNNNN-N (7 digits + checksum). Also the company's tax number.
fields.limitations: Identifies the legal entity, not individual establishments.
fields.analysis_notes: Primary key and the main join key across all PRH datasets. The Finnish VAT number is derived as FI + the 8 digits with the dash removed.

fields.meaning: Date the Business ID itself was assigned.
fields.limitations: May differ from the entity's trade-register registrationDate (top-level field).
fields.analysis_notes: The Y-tunnus scheme started in 1978-03-15, which is why many older companies share that exact date here.

fields.meaning: Code for the authority/system that recorded the business ID.
fields.code_list: PRH source code list (not published inline)
fields.limitations: Numeric code without an embedded description; meaning not documented in the payload.
fields.analysis_notes: Provenance metadata. Keep verbatim; do not interpret without the official code list.

fields.meaning: European unique identifier (EUID) used in the EU Business Registers Interconnection System (BRIS), e.g. FIFPRO.<businessId>.
fields.limitations: Present for 18/100 in sample; populated mainly for limited companies subject to BRIS.
fields.analysis_notes: Secondary join key for cross-EU registry linkage (BRIS). FIFPRO = Finland, PRH register.

fields.meaning: Source code for the EUID record.
fields.limitations: Numeric code, undocumented inline.
fields.analysis_notes: Provenance metadata.

fields.meaning: A registered company/trade name (current or historical).
fields.limitations: Array holds full name history; pick the current one by type + null endDate.
fields.analysis_notes: Current legal name = entry with type=1 and endDate null. Form suffixes Oy (fi) / Ab (sv) = limited company.

fields.meaning: Kind of name. Observed: 1 = primary trade name (toiminimi), 2 = parallel company name (rinnakkaistoiminimi), 3 = auxiliary trade name (aputoiminimi), 4 = auxiliary-name detail.
fields.limitations: Codes 2 and 4 are rare; meanings inferred from PRH conventions, not from inline descriptions.
fields.analysis_notes: type=3 auxiliary names are alternate brands the entity may trade under (e.g. 'Eniro', 'Sentraali').

fields.meaning: Date this name was registered.
Date this name stopped being valid; null means still current.
fields.analysis_notes: Null endDate identifies the active name within the array.

fields.meaning: Version counter for the name record.
Source code for the name record.
fields.limitations: Undocumented numeric code.

fields.meaning: Industry classification code for the company's main line of business.
fields.code_list: Finnish TOL / Statistics Finland (NACE-derived); code set named in typeCodeSet
fields.limitations: Absent for 8/100 records. Different vintages possible (see typeCodeSet).
fields.analysis_notes: TOL codes map to NACE Rev.2 5-digit. Use descriptions[] for human labels.

fields.meaning: Multilingual labels for the industry code; each has languageCode (1=fi,2=sv,3=en) and description.
fields.analysis_notes: Pick languageCode=3 for English label.

fields.meaning: Which classification vintage the code belongs to (e.g. TOIMI2, TOIMI4).
fields.limitations: Mixed vintages across the register; normalize before cross-company comparison.
fields.analysis_notes: TOIMI4 ~ TOL 2025; older entities may carry TOIMI2/3 codes.

fields.meaning: Date this industry classification was recorded.
Legal form code of the entity.
fields.code_list: PRH company form codes (16=limited company, etc.)
fields.limitations: Array carries form history; current form = entry with null endDate.
fields.analysis_notes: Use descriptions[] languageCode=3 for English label.

fields.meaning: Multilingual labels for the legal form.
fields.analysis_notes: Common forms: Limited company (Oy), Housing corporation (Asunto Oy), Limited partnership (Ky), Partnership (Ay), Non-profit association (ry).

fields.meaning: Date the entity left this legal form; null = current.
Special legal situations such as bankruptcy, liquidation, restructuring, or reorganization.
fields.limitations: Empty in all 100 sample records, so the element sub-schema could not be observed; structure assumed similar to registeredEntries (type + descriptions[] + dates).
fields.analysis_notes: Important risk signal when populated (bankruptcy/liquidation). Confirm sub-fields against the live API on a known-distressed entity before relying on it.

fields.meaning: Status code of the entry within a given register (e.g. 1=Registered, 4=Ceased; for tax registers 80=VAT-liable, 82=VAT on property rights, 55=employer registered, 41=prepayment registered).
fields.limitations: Meaning is register-dependent; always read together with the register field and descriptions[].
fields.analysis_notes: registeredEntries is the richest section: it encodes Trade Register membership AND tax registrations (VAT/employer/prepayment).

fields.meaning: Multilingual label of the entry status/type.
example_values: VAT-obliged for the transfer of rights to use immovable property

fields.meaning: Which register the entry belongs to. Observed: 1=Business Information System (YTJ), 4=Trade Register (PRH), 5=Employer Register (Tax), 6=VAT Register (Tax), 7=Prepayment Register (Tax/ennakkoperintärekisteri).
fields.limitations: Register meanings inferred from the entry descriptions in the sample; confirm against official PRH code list before hard-coding.
fields.analysis_notes: Presence of register 6 with type 80 = company is VAT registered. Register 5 = registered employer. Register 7 = in prepayment register. Valuable firmographic flags.

fields.meaning: Authority maintaining the entry (e.g. 1=Tax Administration, 2=PRH — inferred).
fields.limitations: Authority meanings inferred (tax-register entries carry authority=1, trade-register/YTJ entries authority=2).

fields.meaning: Validity window of the register entry; null endDate = currently in that register.
fields.analysis_notes: Active tax registration = matching register entry with null endDate.

fields.meaning: Company website as registered with PRH.
fields.limitations: Present for 6/100 in sample; not normalized (may lack scheme, inconsistent casing). No email/phone is available in open data, but website is.
fields.analysis_notes: Only contact-style field available. Normalize to a canonical URL on ingest. Also has registrationDate and source.

fields.meaning: Registered addresses. type=1 visiting address, type=2 postal address. Fields: street, buildingNumber, entrance, apartmentNumber, apartmentIdSuffix, co, postCode, postOfficeBox, postOffices[] (city + languageCode + municipalityCode), registrationDate, source.
fields.code_list: Finnish municipality codes (Statistics Finland) in postOffices[].municipalityCode
fields.language: City names in fi and sv (postOffices[] per languageCode)
fields.limitations: Present for 34/100 in sample (mostly active/recent entities). Ceased entities often have none.
fields.analysis_notes: postOffices[] gives bilingual city (HELSINKI/HELSINGFORS) sharing one municipalityCode (091=Helsinki). Use municipalityCode as the geography join key.

fields.meaning: The entity's status in the Trade Register. Observed: 1=active/registered, 4=ceased, 3=intermediate (e.g. removal pending / special). THIS is the real active-vs-ceased indicator.
fields.limitations: Code 3 meaning not confirmed (1 record in sample). Correlates exactly with top-level endDate (status 4 <-> endDate present).
fields.analysis_notes: USE THIS for active/ceased, NOT the `status` field. Derive: active = tradeRegisterStatus==1.

fields.meaning: A status code whose meaning is unclear; constant value '2' across the entire 100-record sample including both active and ceased entities.
fields.limitations: Constant '2' for active AND ceased companies in the sample, so it does NOT indicate liveness. Easy to misread as active/inactive.
fields.analysis_notes: DO NOT use as active/ceased indicator. Possibly 'company-level record status'. Keep verbatim; rely on tradeRegisterStatus instead.

fields.meaning: Date the entity was registered in the Trade Register (effective incorporation/registration date).
fields.limitations: Absent for 6/100 records (older/edge entities).
fields.analysis_notes: Best available incorporation date. May predate businessId.registrationDate (Y-tunnus scheme started 1978).

fields.meaning: Date the entity ceased / was removed from the Trade Register; null = still active.
fields.limitations: Present for 67/100 in sample (sample skews to old, ceased entities).
fields.analysis_notes: Null endDate + tradeRegisterStatus==1 = active company.

fields.meaning: Timestamp the company record was last updated in PRH (datetime, no timezone shown).
fields.limitations: Present for 71/100 in sample. Timezone not specified (assume Europe/Helsinki).
fields.analysis_notes: Use for incremental/delta ingestion and to detect changed records between daily crawls.
